dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Pumpkin Muffin came into ACC as a stray. Because of this, we do not know how she is in a home environment. During her time in the care center she has been observed to have on leash reactivity towards people resulting in her growling at people approaching her while on leash. She has been noted to have high levels of fear and anxiety, she is noted to pace in kennel, repeatedly lip lick and have whale eyes on walks. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Pumpkin Muffin
